plan.notes: Source: HSU official 2026-2027 Degree Plans index, Physics (2026-2027 Catalog) PDF, Version 2024/10/7. Header states the plan is 'a suggested program of courses' and 'does not substitute for the HSU catalog'. Genuine term-by-term sequence sums 14+15+15+17+15+15+14+15 = 120; all printed semester totals reconcile with the course rows. The document is titled simply 'Physics' and serves the Traditional track; the index page additionally lists an Astronomy track link whose 2026-2027 PDF was not locatable, so no astronomy-track sequence is recorded (see inventory). 'X or Y' choice slots use the first-listed code. ELECTIVE placeholders use code 'ELECTIVE' because the catalog names only the slot, not a course.
